create_RollDataset: create a RollDataset that wraps an existing dataset and shifts each item by a specified number of positions using torch.roll
use_RollDataset_getitem: use RollDataset getitem to retrieve a shifted tensor item from the wrapped dataset at a given index
review_RollDataset_init: review the RollDataset constructor to understand how it stores the wrapped dataset and shift amount
test_RollDataset: test the RollDataset class by wrapping a sample dataset and verifying items are correctly rolled by the specified shifts
refactor_RollDataset: refactor the RollDataset class to support dynamic per-item shift values instead of a fixed shift amount
